content.description: New page at /processes/monitor showing all running process instances. Table with: Process Name, Status badge, Progress (current/total + bar), Trigger Type, Entity, Started, Duration. Filterable by status. Auto-refresh every 10s. Summary stats at top from /api/v1/process-engine/dashboard. Click row navigates to instance detail (future F-016).
acceptance_criteria: Page exists at /processes/monitor and is accessible from sidebar or Process Hub
Summary stats row at top: Total, Pending, In Progress, Waiting Approval, Completed, Failed
Table shows process instances fetched from GET /api/v1/process-engine/instances
Table columns: Process Name, Status (color badge), Progress (currentStep/totalSteps + bar), Trigger, Entity Type, Started (relative), Duration
Status badges: pending=slate, in_progress=blue, waiting_approval=amber, completed=emerald, failed=rose, cancelled=gray
Filter by status via select dropdown, triggers re-fetch
Empty state when no instances exist
Click row navigates to /processes/instances/[id] (page can be placeholder for now)
Dark mode support on all elements
edge_cases: Zero process instances — show empty state with link to Process Hub
Very long process names — truncate with ellipsis
Fetch fails (401/500) — show error state with retry button
SLA deadline passed — could show red indicator (stretch goal)
error_handling: API 500 — show error message with retry
content.implementation_notes: Create a client component page at src/app/(dashboard)/processes/monitor/page.tsx. Fetches from 2 endpoints: /api/v1/process-engine/dashboard (stats) and /api/v1/process-engine/instances (table data). Uses useState/useEffect with 10s polling interval. Status filter as query param. Add a link to /processes/monitor from the Process Hub page header.
affected_files: src/app/(dashboard)/processes/page.tsx — add link to monitor page
testing_requirements: Page renders with stats and table
Empty state renders when no instances
